# Operations reference

<!-- Generated by `python3 scripts/fcskill.py describe --markdown`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Units: millimetres and degrees. Every step is `{"op": "<name>", ...params}`; any step may add
`"expect": {...}` (see [`check`](#check)) and `"comment"`.

## Solids

### `box`

Parametric box (Part::Box). 'position' is the minimum corner; the box extends along +X/+Y/+Z.

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `length` | number | **yes** |  | > 0; `=expr` ok | Size along X. |
| `width` | number | **yes** |  | > 0; `=expr` ok | Size along Y. |
| `height` | number | **yes** |  | > 0; `=expr` ok | Size along Z. |
| `name` | newname |  |  |  | Name of the new object (identifier). Default: auto ('Box', 'Box001', ...). |
| `position` | vector |  | `[0, 0, 0]` |  | Placement position [x, y, z] in mm. |
| `rotation` | rotation |  |  |  | Orientation as {"axis": [x,y,z], "angle": deg}, applied about the position point. |

```json
{"op": "box", "name": "Plate", "length": 100, "width": 60, "height": 8}
```

### `cylinder`

Parametric cylinder (Part::Cylinder). 'position' is the centre of the bottom face; the axis points along 'direction' (default +Z).

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `radius` | number | **yes** |  | > 0; `=expr` ok | Radius. |
| `height` | number | **yes** |  | > 0; `=expr` ok | Height along the axis. |
| `name` | newname |  |  |  | Name of the new object (identifier). Default: auto ('Cylinder', 'Cylinder001', ...). |
| `position` | vector |  | `[0, 0, 0]` |  | Placement position [x, y, z] in mm. |
| `direction` | vector |  |  |  | Axis direction of the solid (alternative to 'rotation'). Default +Z. |
| `rotation` | rotation |  |  |  | Orientation as {"axis": [x,y,z], "angle": deg}, applied about the position point. |

```json
{"op": "cylinder", "name": "Hole", "radius": 3, "height": 20, "position": [10, 10, -5]}
```

### `sphere`

Parametric sphere (Part::Sphere) centred on 'position'.

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `radius` | number | **yes** |  | > 0; `=expr` ok | Radius. |
| `name` | newname |  |  |  | Name of the new object (identifier). Default: auto ('Sphere', 'Sphere001', ...). |
| `position` | vector |  | `[0, 0, 0]` |  | Placement position [x, y, z] in mm. |

### `cone`

Parametric cone or frustum (Part::Cone). 'position' is the centre of the bottom face (radius1).

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `radius1` | number | **yes** |  | ≥ 0; `=expr` ok | Bottom radius. |
| `radius2` | number | **yes** |  | ≥ 0; `=expr` ok | Top radius (0 for a pointed cone). |
| `height` | number | **yes** |  | > 0; `=expr` ok | Height along the axis. |
| `name` | newname |  |  |  | Name of the new object (identifier). Default: auto ('Cone', 'Cone001', ...). |
| `position` | vector |  | `[0, 0, 0]` |  | Placement position [x, y, z] in mm. |
| `direction` | vector |  |  |  | Axis direction of the solid (alternative to 'rotation'). Default +Z. |
| `rotation` | rotation |  |  |  | Orientation as {"axis": [x,y,z], "angle": deg}, applied about the position point. |

### `torus`

Parametric torus (Part::Torus) centred on 'position', ring in the plane normal to 'direction'.

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `radius1` | number | **yes** |  | > 0; `=expr` ok | Major radius: axis to tube centre. |
| `radius2` | number | **yes** |  | > 0; `=expr` ok | Minor radius: tube radius. Must be < radius1. |
| `name` | newname |  |  |  | Name of the new object (identifier). Default: auto ('Torus', 'Torus001', ...). |
| `position` | vector |  | `[0, 0, 0]` |  | Placement position [x, y, z] in mm. |
| `direction` | vector |  |  |  | Axis direction of the solid (alternative to 'rotation'). Default +Z. |
| `rotation` | rotation |  |  |  | Orientation as {"axis": [x,y,z], "angle": deg}, applied about the position point. |

### `prism`

Parametric regular polygonal prism (Part::Prism). 'position' is the centre of the bottom face.

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sides` | integer | **yes** |  | ≥ 3 | Number of polygon sides. |
| `circumradius` | number | **yes** |  | > 0; `=expr` ok | Distance from centre to a polygon corner. |
| `height` | number | **yes** |  | > 0; `=expr` ok | Height along the axis. |
| `name` | newname |  |  |  | Name of the new object (identifier). Default: auto ('Prism', 'Prism001', ...). |
| `position` | vector |  | `[0, 0, 0]` |  | Placement position [x, y, z] in mm. |
| `direction` | vector |  |  |  | Axis direction of the solid (alternative to 'rotation'). Default +Z. |
| `rotation` | rotation |  |  |  | Orientation as {"axis": [x,y,z], "angle": deg}, applied about the position point. |

### `import`

Import a solid from a STEP/IGES/BREP/FCStd file or a closed mesh (STL/OBJ/3MF/PLY/OFF) in the workspace, or a ready-made part from the official FreeCAD library (bearings, motors, fasteners, profiles, electronics...). Find library parts with 'fcskill.py library <keywords>'.

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `library` | string |  |  |  | Library part, as given by 'fcskill.py library' ('part'), e.g. 'Mechanical Parts/Bearings/608ZZ_Ball_Bearing'. Downloaded on first use. |
| `file` | path |  |  |  | A .step/.stp, .iges/.igs, .brep or .FCStd file, or a .stl/.obj/.3mf/.ply/.off mesh, in the workspace. |
| `refine` | bool |  | `true` |  | Meshes: merge coplanar triangles into larger faces (cleaner, faster booleans). Skipped above 10000 triangles. |
| `anchor` | enum |  | `"origin"` | `origin` \| `center` \| `bottom_center` \| `min_corner` | Which point of the part's bounding box lands on 'position': as modelled ('origin'), 'center', 'bottom_center' or 'min_corner'. |
| `position` | vector |  | `[0, 0, 0]` |  | Where the anchor goes. |
| `rotation` | rotation |  |  |  | Rotation about the anchor point, after anchoring. |
| `name` | newname |  |  |  | Name of the new object (identifier). Default: auto ('Imported', 'Imported001', ...). |

Give exactly one of: `library`, `file`.

The result is a fixed shape: place, cut, fuse, measure, give it a material or add it to an assembly, but its dimensions are not editable. Check the reported bbox: library parts keep their author's orientation. Library parts are CC-BY 3.0: pass the reported 'attribution' on to the user. A mesh becomes a solid made of its triangles (flat facets, no true cylinders), so cut, fuse, measure and export work, but fillets on its edges and FEM are unreliable. Meshes must be closed and manifold (repair them first otherwise), up to 20000 triangles, and are slow to work with (booleans take seconds per few thousand triangles); mesh files carry no units, so check the reported bbox (CHECK_UNITS warns when the size is implausible).

```json
{"op": "import", "library": "Mechanical Parts/Bearings/608ZZ_Ball_Bearing", "name": "Bearing", "anchor": "center", "position": [0, 0, 20]}
```

## Profiles

### `extrude`

Extrude a closed polygon (Part::Polygon + Part::Extrusion). Points are editable afterwards.

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `points` | points |  |  |  | Quick polygon: corners in order, >=3. [a, b] are 2D coordinates in 'plane'; [x, y, z] are absolute. |
| `shapes` | shapes |  |  |  | Profile as closed shapes (builds an editable Sketch): {"rect": [x0, y0, x1, y1], "corner_radius": r}, {"circle": [cx, cy], "radius": r}, {"slot": [[x1, y1], [x2, y2]], "radius": r}, {"polygon": [[x, y], ...], "corner_radius": r} (or "radii": [...] per corner), {"spline": [[x, y], ...]} (smooth closed curve through >=3 points), {"path": [[x, y], [x, y], {"arc_to": [x, y], "center": [cx, cy], "clockwise": false}, {"spline_to": [x, y], "through": [[x, y], ...], "start_tangent": [dx, dy], "end_tangent": [dx, dy]}, ...]}. Shapes inside another shape become holes. Splines pass exactly through their points and can bulge between them; use a path with straight segments and spline_to for flat sides. |
| `plane` | enum |  | `"XY"` | `XY` \| `XZ` \| `YZ` | Plane of 2D coordinates: XY -> (x, y, 0), XZ -> (x, 0, z), YZ -> (0, y, z). |
| `offset` | number |  | `0` | `=expr` ok | With 'shapes': distance of the profile plane from the origin along its normal. In a body this can be an expression that follows the part, e.g. '=Base.Length'. |
| `height` | number |  |  | > 0; `=expr` ok | Extrusion distance along the plane normal (see notes). |
| `direction` | vector |  |  |  | Explicit extrusion vector; its length is the distance. |
| `symmetric` | bool |  | `false` |  | Extrude half the distance to each side of the plane. |
| `body` | name |  |  |  | PartDesign body to add this feature to (see op 'body'). Omit for a stand-alone Part solid. |
| `mode` | enum |  | `"add"` | `add` \| `remove` | In a body: 'add' material (Pad/Revolution) or 'remove' it (Pocket/Groove). |
| `through_all` | bool |  | `false` |  | In a body with mode 'remove': cut through the whole part instead of 'height'. |
| `reversed` | bool |  | `false` |  | In a body: flip the direction (add goes along the plane normal, remove goes against it). |
| `name` | newname |  |  |  | Name of the new object (identifier). Default: auto ('Extrude', 'Extrude001', ...). |

Give exactly one of: `points`, `shapes`.

Give 'height' (or 'direction' outside a body; or 'through_all' when removing in a body). Plane normals (extrusion direction): XY -> +Z, XZ -> +Y, YZ -> +X. Use 'points' for a quick straight-edged polygon (closed automatically; do not repeat the first point) or 'shapes' for arcs, rounded corners, circles, slots and holes. Shapes must be disjoint or fully nested; a path closes back to its start.

```json
{"op": "extrude", "name": "Plate", "height": 6, "shapes": [{"rect": [0, 0, 80, 50], "corner_radius": 5}, {"circle": [10, 10], "radius": 3.25}, {"slot": [[30, 25], [50, 25]], "radius": 4}]}
```

### `revolve`

Revolve a closed polygon around an axis (Part::Polygon + Part::Revolution).

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `points` | points |  |  |  | Quick polygon profile (see 'extrude'). The profile must not cross the axis. |
| `shapes` | shapes |  |  |  | Profile as closed shapes (builds an editable Sketch): {"rect": [x0, y0, x1, y1], "corner_radius": r}, {"circle": [cx, cy], "radius": r}, {"slot": [[x1, y1], [x2, y2]], "radius": r}, {"polygon": [[x, y], ...], "corner_radius": r} (or "radii": [...] per corner), {"spline": [[x, y], ...]} (smooth closed curve through >=3 points), {"path": [[x, y], [x, y], {"arc_to": [x, y], "center": [cx, cy], "clockwise": false}, {"spline_to": [x, y], "through": [[x, y], ...], "start_tangent": [dx, dy], "end_tangent": [dx, dy]}, ...]}. Shapes inside another shape become holes. Splines pass exactly through their points and can bulge between them; use a path with straight segments and spline_to for flat sides. |
| `plane` | enum |  | `"XY"` | `XY` \| `XZ` \| `YZ` | Plane of 2D coordinates. |
| `offset` | number |  | `0` | `=expr` ok | With 'shapes': distance of the profile plane from the origin along its normal. In a body this can be an expression that follows the part, e.g. '=Base.Length'. |
| `axis` | vector |  | `[0, 1, 0]` |  | Revolution axis direction. |
| `center` | vector |  | `[0, 0, 0]` |  | A point on the revolution axis. |
| `angle` | number |  | `360` | > 0; ≤ 360; `=expr` ok | Sweep angle in degrees. |
| `body` | name |  |  |  | PartDesign body to add this feature to (see op 'body'). Omit for a stand-alone Part solid. |
| `mode` | enum |  | `"add"` | `add` \| `remove` | In a body: 'add' material (Pad/Revolution) or 'remove' it (Pocket/Groove). |
| `name` | newname |  |  |  | Name of the new object (identifier). Default: auto ('Revolve', 'Revolve001', ...). |

Give exactly one of: `points`, `shapes`.

Give 'height' (or 'direction' outside a body; or 'through_all' when removing in a body). Plane normals (extrusion direction): XY -> +Z, XZ -> +Y, YZ -> +X. Use 'points' for a quick straight-edged polygon (closed automatically; do not repeat the first point) or 'shapes' for arcs, rounded corners, circles, slots and holes. Shapes must be disjoint or fully nested; a path closes back to its start.

```json
{"op": "revolve", "name": "Bushing", "points": [[10, 0], [20, 0], [20, 5], [14, 5], [14, 30], [10, 30]], "axis": [0, 1, 0]}
```

### `loft`

Smooth solid through cross-sections (Part::Loft; in a body AdditiveLoft/SubtractiveLoft). For organic shapes: mouse shells, handles, bottles, transitions between a square and a round end.

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sections` | sections | **yes** |  |  | Cross-sections in order, >=2: {"shape": one closed shape (see extrude 'shapes', no holes), "plane": "XY"|"XZ"|"YZ", "offset": distance along the plane normal (number or '=expression')}. |
| `ruled` | bool |  | `false` |  | Straight faces between sections instead of a smooth surface. |
| `closed` | bool |  | `false` |  | Loop back from the last section to the first (a ring). |
| `body` | name |  |  |  | PartDesign body to add this feature to (see op 'body'). Omit for a stand-alone Part solid. |
| `mode` | enum |  | `"add"` | `add` \| `remove` | In a body: 'add' material or 'remove' it. |
| `name` | newname |  |  |  | Name of the new object (identifier). Default: auto ('Loft', 'Loft001', ...). |

Each section is drawn in its plane like an extrude profile (XY: (x, y) at z = offset; XZ: (x, z) at y = offset; YZ: (y, z) at x = offset). Sections usually share a plane type with increasing offsets. Smooth lofts can bulge between sections; add sections where the shape must be controlled. Edit with set: {"sections": [...]} (same number of sections).

```json
{"op": "loft", "name": "Shell", "sections": [{"shape": {"rect": [-20, -15, 20, 15], "corner_radius": 4}, "plane": "XY", "offset": 0}, {"shape": {"circle": [0, 0], "radius": 12}, "plane": "XY", "offset": 30}, {"shape": {"circle": [0, 0], "radius": 6}, "plane": "XY", "offset": 50}]}
```

### `sweep`

Sweep a profile along a path (Part::Sweep; in a body AdditivePipe/SubtractivePipe): tubes, handles, rails, springs and threads.

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `shapes` | shapes | **yes** |  |  | Profile: one closed outline, optionally with holes (a tube), drawn in 2D around the start of the path (see notes). Same shape syntax as extrude. |
| `path` | path3d |  |  |  | Path through [x, y, z] points (>=2), absolute (in a body: body coordinates). |
| `smooth` | bool |  | `false` |  | With 'path': a smooth curve through the points instead of straight segments. |
| `corner_radius` | number |  |  | ≥ 0 | With 'path': round the corners between straight segments (bent tube). |
| `helix` | helix |  |  |  | Helical path: {"radius": r, "pitch": p, "height": h, "left_handed": false, "center": [x, y, z], "axis": [0, 0, 1]}. Starts at center + radius along the local X. |
| `up` | vector |  |  |  | Direction of the profile's y axis at the start (default +Z, or +X when the path starts vertically; the helix axis for a helix). |
| `body` | name |  |  |  | PartDesign body to add this feature to (see op 'body'). Omit for a stand-alone Part solid. |
| `mode` | enum |  | `"add"` | `add` \| `remove` | In a body: 'add' material or 'remove' it. |
| `name` | newname |  |  |  | Name of the new object (identifier). Default: auto ('Sweep', 'Sweep001', ...). |

Give exactly one of: `path`, `helix`.

The profile is placed at the start of the path, perpendicular to it: profile (0, 0) sits on the path, its y axis points along 'up' and x points to the right when looking along the path (on a helix: radially outward). The response reports this 'profile_frame'. A spring is a circle swept along a helix; a thread is a triangle swept along a helix with mode remove or add. Edit with set: path, smooth, corner_radius, helix, up, shapes.

```json
{"op": "sweep", "name": "Handle", "shapes": [{"circle": [0, 0], "radius": 6}, {"circle": [0, 0], "radius": 4}], "path": [[0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 40], [60, 0, 40], [60, 0, 0]], "corner_radius": 12}
```

### `text`

Text as a solid: letters from a font (Draft ShapeString), extruded along the plane normal. Fuse it onto a part for raised lettering, or cut it from the part to engrave it.

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | label | **yes** |  |  | The text (one line, up to 100 characters). |
| `size` | number | **yes** |  | > 0 | Height of capital letters, in mm. |
| `height` | number | **yes** |  | > 0; `=expr` ok | Extrusion distance along the plane normal (letter depth). |
| `position` | vector |  | `[0, 0, 0]` |  | Where the 'align' point of the text goes (absolute [x, y, z]). |
| `plane` | enum |  | `"XY"` | `XY` \| `XZ` \| `YZ` | Plane the text lies in: XY reads from above (+Z), XZ from the front (-Y), YZ from the right (+X). |
| `align` | enum |  | `"bottom_left"` | `bottom_left` \| `bottom_center` \| `bottom_right` \| `middle_left` \| `center` \| `middle_right` \| `top_left` \| `top_center` \| `top_right` | Which point of the text lands on 'position' (bottom = baseline, top = cap height). |
| `angle` | number |  | `0` |  | Rotation in the plane, counter-clockwise as read, in degrees. |
| `reversed` | bool |  | `false` |  | Extrude against the plane normal instead of along it. |
| `font` | path |  |  |  | A .ttf/.otf font file in the workspace. Default: FreeCAD's bundled osifont (a plain technical font). |
| `name` | newname |  |  |  | Name of the new object (identifier). Default: auto ('Text', 'Text001', ...). |

Extrusion goes along the plane normal: XY -> +Z, XZ -> +Y, YZ -> +X ('reversed' flips it). To engrave a top face at z = 10 by 1 mm: text at z = 9 with height 2, then cut it (the extra 1 mm passes through the face). For raised text, start it inside the face (z = 9.9) and fuse. Each letter is a separate solid until fused or cut. Edit with set: text, size, font, align, height.

```json
{"op": "text", "name": "Label", "text": "V2.1", "size": 8, "height": 2, "position": [40, 25, 5], "align": "center"}
```

## PartDesign

### `body`

Create a PartDesign body: a single solid built feature by feature (pad, pocket, hole, fillet, ...), the way FreeCAD users model parts. Add features with extrude/revolve/hole using 'body', and dress-ups with fillet/chamfer/shell on the body.

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | newname |  |  |  | Name of the new object (identifier). Default: auto ('Body', 'Body001', ...). |
| `position` | vector |  | `[0, 0, 0]` |  | Placement position [x, y, z] in mm. |
| `rotation` | rotation |  |  |  | Orientation as {"axis": [x,y,z], "angle": deg}, applied about the position point. |

Sketches are attached to the body's origin planes, so profile coordinates are always body coordinates. Use 'offset' expressions (e.g. '=Base.Length') to keep features on faces when dimensions change.

```json
{"op": "body", "name": "Bracket"}
```

### `hole`

Drill one or more holes into a body (PartDesign::Hole): simple, counterbored or countersunk, sized from metric screw tables or an explicit diameter. Holes start at the profile plane and go against its normal.

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `body` | name | **yes** |  |  | Body to drill. |
| `at` | centers | **yes** |  |  | Hole centres as [a, b] in 'plane' (one hole per point); >= 1 point. |
| `plane` | enum |  | `"XY"` | `XY` \| `XZ` \| `YZ` | Plane of the 'at' coordinates. |
| `offset` | number |  | `0` | `=expr` ok | Distance of the starting plane along its normal, usually the face the hole starts on, e.g. '=Base.Length'. |
| `size` | enum |  |  | `M2` \| `M2.5` \| `M3` \| `M4` \| `M5` \| `M6` \| `M8` \| `M10` \| `M12` \| `M14` \| `M16` \| `M20` | Metric screw size; sets the diameter from 'fit' and the seat from 'type'. |
| `fit` | enum |  | `"clearance"` | `clearance` \| `tap` | With 'size': 'clearance' (ISO 273 medium) for a screw to pass, 'tap' for a tap drill (an unthreaded bore at the tap drill size). Ignored when 'threaded'. |
| `diameter` | number |  |  | > 0; `=expr` ok | Explicit hole diameter (instead of 'size'). |
| `threaded` | bool |  | `false` |  | With 'size' and type 'simple': model the ISO metric coarse thread (class 6H) in the hole, over its whole depth, e.g. for a threaded hole in a printed part or a model that shows the thread. |
| `type` | enum |  | `"simple"` | `simple` \| `counterbore` \| `countersink` | Hole seat. |
| `cut_diameter` | number |  |  | > 0 | Counterbore/countersink diameter (default from 'size'). |
| `cut_depth` | number |  |  | > 0 | Counterbore depth (default from 'size'). |
| `depth` | number |  |  | > 0; `=expr` ok | Hole depth; omit to drill through all. |
| `reversed` | bool |  | `false` |  | Drill along the plane normal instead of against it. |
| `name` | newname |  |  |  | Name of the new object (identifier). Default: auto ('Hole', 'Hole001', ...). |

Give exactly one of: `size`, `diameter`.

Counterbores fit ISO 4762 socket head screws (DIN 974-1); countersinks fit ISO 10642 (90 degrees). A 'threaded' hole is bored at the thread's minor diameter and the thread is real geometry (slower to compute and export than a plain hole; give 'depth' for blind tapped holes).

```json
{"op": "hole", "body": "Bracket", "at": [[10, 10], [70, 10]], "offset": "=Base.Length", "size": "M5", "type": "counterbore"}
```

## Assemblies

### `assembly`

Create an assembly (native Assembly workbench) whose parts are links to existing solids or bodies. The first part is grounded (fixed in place) unless others are marked 'ground'. Then connect parts with 'joint'.

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `parts` | parts | **yes** |  |  | Parts: [{"object": "Base"}, {"object": "Pin", "name": "Pin1", "position": [x, y, z], "ground": false}, ...]. The same object can be added several times under different names. |
| `name` | newname |  |  |  | Name of the new object (identifier). Default: auto ('Assembly', 'Assembly001', ...). |

Each part is a link: editing the original object updates every instance. The originals become intermediates; the assembly is the result (export/render/measure it). Overlapping parts are reported as 'interferences'.

```json
{"op": "assembly", "name": "Hinge", "parts": [{"object": "Base"}, {"object": "Pin"}]}
```

### `joint`

Connect two parts of an assembly with a joint and solve. Each side names a part and exactly one face or edge (selector). Every joint is checked to be satisfied after solving, and part overlaps are reported.

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `assembly` | name | **yes** |  |  | Assembly to add the joint to. |
| `type` | enum | **yes** |  | `fixed` \| `revolute` \| `cylindrical` \| `slider` \| `ball` \| `parallel` \| `perpendicular` | fixed: rigid; revolute: hinge (shared axis and point); cylindrical: rotate + slide on an axis; slider: slide on an axis without rotation; ball: shared point; parallel / perpendicular: axes only. |
| `a` | jointref | **yes** |  |  | First side: {"part": "Base", "face": ">Z"} or {"part": "Base", "edge": "%CIRCLE and >Z"}. |
| `b` | jointref | **yes** |  |  | Second side (this part moves to meet the first). |
| `offset` | number |  | `0` |  | Distance of part b from side a along the joint axis: positive moves it away from a's surface (out of the material), negative into it (e.g. -10 sinks a pin 10 mm into a hole). |
| `name` | newname |  |  |  | Name of the new object (identifier). Default: auto ('Joint', 'Joint001', ...). |

A face gives a frame at its centre with Z along its normal; a circular edge gives its centre and axis. Faces touching face-to-face (e.g. a block on a plate) usually need type 'fixed'.

```json
{"op": "joint", "assembly": "Hinge", "type": "revolute", "a": {"part": "Base", "edge": "%CIRCLE and >Z"}, "b": {"part": "Pin", "edge": "%CIRCLE and <Z"}}
```

## Booleans

### `cut`

Subtract tool(s) from a base (Part::Cut). Inputs stay editable; the result is checked to have actually removed material.

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `base` | name | **yes** |  |  | Object to cut from. |
| `tool` | name |  |  |  | Single cutting object. |
| `tools` | names |  |  |  | Several cutting objects (fused automatically). |
| `refine` | bool |  | `true` |  | Merge coplanar faces in the result (recommended before fillets). |
| `name` | newname |  |  |  | Name of the new object (identifier). Default: auto ('Cut', 'Cut001', ...). |

Give exactly one of: `tool`, `tools`.

Tip: make cutting tools extend past the faces they cut (e.g. a hole cylinder 1 mm above and below a plate) to avoid coincident-face failures.

```json
{"op": "cut", "name": "DrilledPlate", "base": "Plate", "tool": "Hole"}
```

### `fuse`

Union of two or more objects (Part::MultiFuse). Warns if the result is not one connected solid.

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `objects` | names | **yes** |  | ≥ 2 items | Objects to unite (>=2). |
| `refine` | bool |  | `true` |  | Merge coplanar faces in the result. |
| `name` | newname |  |  |  | Name of the new object (identifier). Default: auto ('Fusion', 'Fusion001', ...). |

### `common`

Intersection of two or more objects (Part::MultiCommon). Fails if the objects do not overlap.

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `objects` | names | **yes** |  | ≥ 2 items | Objects to intersect (>=2). |
| `refine` | bool |  | `true` |  | Merge coplanar faces in the result. |
| `name` | newname |  |  |  | Name of the new object (identifier). Default: auto ('Common', 'Common001', ...). |

## Features

### `fillet`

Round edges (Part::Fillet). Selector-based edge choices are re-evaluated when upstream dimensions change.

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | name | **yes** |  |  | Object to operate on. |
| `radius` | number | **yes** |  | > 0 | Fillet radius. |
| `edges` | selector |  | `"all"` |  | Edges to round: 'all', 1-based indices, or a selector like '|Z', '>Z', 'face(>Z)'. Use inspect with topology=true to see edges. |
| `name` | newname |  |  |  | Name of the new object (identifier). Default: auto ('Fillet', 'Fillet001', ...). |

```json
{"op": "fillet", "target": "Plate", "radius": 2, "edges": "|Z"}
```

### `chamfer`

Bevel edges with equal setback (Part::Chamfer).

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | name | **yes** |  |  | Object to operate on. |
| `size` | number | **yes** |  | > 0 | Chamfer setback distance. |
| `edges` | selector |  | `"all"` |  | Edges to chamfer (see 'fillet'). |
| `name` | newname |  |  |  | Name of the new object (identifier). Default: auto ('Chamfer', 'Chamfer001', ...). |

### `shell`

Hollow a solid leaving walls of 'thickness' (Part::Thickness), removing 'open_faces'.

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | name | **yes** |  |  | Object to operate on. |
| `thickness` | number | **yes** |  | > 0 | Wall thickness. |
| `open_faces` | selector | **yes** |  |  | Faces to remove, e.g. '>Z' for an open-top box. Required: at least one face. |
| `outward` | bool |  | `false` |  | Grow walls outward instead of inward (keeps inner dimensions). |
| `join` | enum |  | `"arc"` | `arc` \| `intersection` | Corner join type. |
| `name` | newname |  |  |  | Name of the new object (identifier). Default: auto ('Shell', 'Shell001', ...). |

```json
{"op": "shell", "target": "Housing", "thickness": 2, "open_faces": ">Z"}
```

## Patterns

### `linear_array`

Repeat an object 'count' times, each copy offset by 'step' (parametric Draft array).

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | name | **yes** |  |  | Object to operate on. |
| `count` | integer | **yes** |  | ≥ 2; ≤ 1000 | Total number of instances, including the original. |
| `step` | vector | **yes** |  |  | Offset between consecutive instances. |
| `fuse` | bool |  | `true` |  | Fuse touching instances into one solid. |
| `name` | newname |  |  |  | Name of the new object (identifier). Default: auto ('LinearArray', 'LinearArray001', ...). |

If 'target' is a feature of a PartDesign body (a pad, pocket, hole, ...), the feature is repeated natively inside the body, in body coordinates; 'fuse' does not apply. A pattern or mirror can't be repeated again: name the original feature.

```json
{"op": "linear_array", "target": "Hole", "count": 4, "step": [20, 0, 0]}
```

### `grid_array`

Rectangular grid of an object along X and Y (optionally Z) (parametric Draft array).

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | name | **yes** |  |  | Object to operate on. |
| `count_x` | integer | **yes** |  | ≥ 1; ≤ 1000 | Instances along X. |
| `count_y` | integer | **yes** |  | ≥ 1; ≤ 1000 | Instances along Y. |
| `step_x` | number | **yes** |  |  | Spacing along X. |
| `step_y` | number | **yes** |  |  | Spacing along Y. |
| `count_z` | integer |  | `1` | ≥ 1; ≤ 1000 | Instances along Z. |
| `step_z` | number |  | `0` |  | Spacing along Z. |
| `fuse` | bool |  | `true` |  | Fuse touching instances into one solid. |
| `name` | newname |  |  |  | Name of the new object (identifier). Default: auto ('GridArray', 'GridArray001', ...). |

If 'target' is a feature of a PartDesign body (a pad, pocket, hole, ...), the feature is repeated natively inside the body, in body coordinates; 'fuse' does not apply. A pattern or mirror can't be repeated again: name the original feature. In a body, the grid is one MultiTransform feature.

```json
{"op": "grid_array", "target": "Vent", "count_x": 5, "count_y": 3, "step_x": 8, "step_y": 8}
```

### `polar_array`

Repeat an object around an axis (parametric Draft polar array).

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | name | **yes** |  |  | Object to operate on. |
| `count` | integer | **yes** |  | ≥ 2; ≤ 1000 | Total number of instances, including the original. |
| `angle` | number |  | `360` | > 0; ≤ 360 | Total angle. 360 spaces instances evenly around the circle; less than 360 puts the first and last instance at the ends of the arc. |
| `axis` | vector |  | `[0, 0, 1]` |  | Rotation axis direction. |
| `center` | vector |  | `[0, 0, 0]` |  | A point on the rotation axis. |
| `fuse` | bool |  | `true` |  | Fuse touching instances into one solid. |
| `name` | newname |  |  |  | Name of the new object (identifier). Default: auto ('PolarArray', 'PolarArray001', ...). |

If 'target' is a feature of a PartDesign body (a pad, pocket, hole, ...), the feature is repeated natively inside the body, in body coordinates; 'fuse' does not apply. A pattern or mirror can't be repeated again: name the original feature.

## Transforms

### `move`

Translate an object by an offset (edits its Placement; the feature tree stays parametric).

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | name | **yes** |  |  | Object to operate on. |
| `offset` | vector | **yes** |  |  | Translation [dx, dy, dz]. |

Moving an input of a boolean moves it inside the boolean result.

### `rotate`

Rotate an object about an axis through 'center' (edits its Placement).

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | name | **yes** |  |  | Object to operate on. |
| `angle` | number | **yes** |  |  | Rotation angle in degrees (right-hand rule). |
| `axis` | vector |  | `[0, 0, 1]` |  | Rotation axis direction. |
| `center` | vector |  | `[0, 0, 0]` |  | Point the axis passes through. |

### `place`

Set an object's absolute position and/or rotation (replaces its Placement components).

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | name | **yes** |  |  | Object to operate on. |
| `position` | vector |  |  |  | New absolute position. |
| `rotation` | rotation |  |  |  | Orientation as {"axis": [x,y,z], "angle": deg}, applied about the position point. |

### `mirror`

Create a mirrored copy of an object (Part::Mirroring). The original is kept. For a feature of a PartDesign body (pad, pocket, hole...), mirrors the feature inside the body (PartDesign::Mirrored).

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | name | **yes** |  |  | Object to operate on. |
| `plane` | enum |  |  | `XY` \| `XZ` \| `YZ` | Mirror plane through 'point'. |
| `normal` | vector |  |  |  | Mirror plane normal (alternative to 'plane'). |
| `point` | vector |  | `[0, 0, 0]` |  | A point on the mirror plane. |
| `name` | newname |  |  |  | Name of the new object (identifier). Default: auto ('Mirror', 'Mirror001', ...). |

Give exactly one of: `plane`, `normal`.

For a body feature, 'point' and 'normal' are body coordinates, and the mirrored copy must touch the part (a body stays one solid). 'fuse' does not apply. A pattern or mirror can't be mirrored again: name the original feature.

```json
{"op": "mirror", "target": "Slot", "plane": "YZ", "point": [40, 0, 0]}
```

### `copy`

Create a linked copy (Draft clone) that follows changes to the original, optionally offset.

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | name | **yes** |  |  | Object to operate on. |
| `offset` | vector |  | `[0, 0, 0]` |  | Translation of the copy. |
| `name` | newname |  |  |  | Name of the new object (identifier). Default: auto ('Copy', 'Copy001', ...). |

### `scale`

Create a scaled version of an object (Draft clone with Scale), about the origin. The original becomes an intermediate.

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | name | **yes** |  |  | Object to operate on. |
| `factor` | number_or_vector | **yes** |  |  | Uniform factor, or [sx, sy, sz]. |
| `name` | newname |  |  |  | Name of the new object (identifier). Default: auto ('Scaled', 'Scaled001', ...). |

## Editing

### `set`

Change properties of an existing object and recompute everything downstream. Use 'inspect' to see editable properties.

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | name | **yes** |  |  | Object to operate on. |
| `properties` | object | **yes** |  |  | Property values, e.g. {"Height": 12, "Radius": "=Params.bore / 2"}. Use null to clear an expression. Also accepts "position" and "rotation", and for fillets/chamfers/shells the op parameters (radius, size, edges, thickness, open_faces). |

```json
{"op": "set", "target": "Plate", "properties": {"Height": 12}}
```

### `set_params`

Create or update named parameters in the 'Params' spreadsheet. Reference them in numeric parameters as '=Params.<name>'.

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `values` | object | **yes** |  |  | Parameter values, e.g. {"wall": 2, "bore": 8}. Numbers are millimetres unless a unit string is given ("15 deg"). |

```json
{"op": "set_params", "values": {"plate_t": 8, "hole_d": 6.5}}
```

### `delete`

Delete objects. Refuses to delete objects other objects depend on, unless 'with_dependents' is true.

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `targets` | names |  |  |  | Objects to delete. |
| `all` | bool |  | `false` |  | Delete every object in the document. |
| `with_dependents` | bool |  | `false` |  | Also delete objects that depend on the targets. |

### `rename`

Change an object's label. Its internal Name never changes; both can be used as references.

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | name | **yes** |  |  | Object to operate on. |
| `label` | label | **yes** |  |  | New label: any text, e.g. 'Base plate' (unique in the document). |

### `material`

Give finished parts a material (FreeCAD material: density, mechanical data, appearance) and/or a colour. Shown when the file is opened in FreeCAD and in render images; measure uses the density for masses.

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `targets` | names | **yes** |  |  | Parts to set (solids, bodies, or assembly parts: the material goes to their source). |
| `material` | string |  |  |  | Preset: steel, steel_s235, steel_s355, stainless_steel, stainless_304, cast_iron, aluminium, aluminium_6061, aluminium_7075, aluminium_5754, titanium, copper, brass, bronze, gold, silver, chrome, pla, abs, petg, nylon, nylon_pa12, pom, polypropylene, polycarbonate, acrylic, ptfe, pvc, rubber, glass, wood, concrete, default; or any FreeCAD library material name (e.g. 'Steel-C45E'). Grades (steel_s235, aluminium_6061, ...) also carry the strength data 'fem_static' uses. |
| `color` | color |  |  |  | Custom colour, '#RRGGBB' or [r, g, b] in 0..1 (e.g. a filament colour); overrides the material's look. |
| `transparency` | integer |  |  | ≥ 0; ≤ 100 | Transparency in percent. |

Give 'material', 'color' or both. Plastic presets come with a neutral default colour; give 'color' for the real one. Colour alone keeps the material set before.

```json
{"op": "material", "targets": ["Rim"], "material": "aluminium"}
```

## Queries

### `inspect`

Describe the document (no target) or one object in detail: properties, dependencies, geometry and optionally faces/edges.

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | name |  |  |  | Object to inspect. Omit for the whole document tree. |
| `topology` | bool |  | `false` |  | Include per-face and per-edge descriptors (indices for selectors). |

### `check`

Assert geometric expectations on an object; fails with EXPECTATION_FAILED if they do not hold.

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | name | **yes** |  |  | Object to operate on. |
| `expect` | expect | **yes** |  |  | Expectations: volume, bbox_size, bbox_min, bbox_max, solids, valid, tolerance (mm, default 0.01), volume_tolerance (relative, default 0.001). |

### `measure`

Clearance and interference between objects (minimum distance, closest points, overlap volume), and each object's mass properties: volume, area, centre of mass and inertia tensor, plus mass with a material. Use it to check that parts fit together and what they weigh.

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `objects` | names |  |  |  | Objects to compare pairwise (default: all result objects). An assembly stands for its parts, measured where they are assembled; name a single part by its link (e.g. Pin_Part). |
| `require` | object |  |  |  | Assertions that fail the step: {"min_clearance": mm} and/or {"no_interference": true}. |
| `material` | string |  |  |  | Material for mass (g): a preset or FreeCAD library material name, as in the 'material' op (e.g. 'steel', 'pla', 'rubber'). Without it, materials assigned with 'material' are used. |
| `density` | number |  |  | > 0 | Explicit density in g/cm3 (instead of 'material'). |

Status per pair: 'clear' (distance > 0), 'touching' (distance 0, no overlap) or 'interfering' (overlap volume > 0). 'properties' gives, per object, the inertia tensor about its centre of mass along the global axes: in g*mm2 ('inertia_g_mm2', with its principal moments) when a density is known, otherwise geometric ('inertia_mm5': multiply by the density in g/mm3). With masses for every object, 'total' gives the combined mass and centre of mass.

```json
{"op": "measure", "objects": ["Lid", "Box"], "require": {"min_clearance": 0.3}}
```

### `fem_static`

Linear static stress analysis (Gmsh + CalculiX, 2nd-order elements): fixed faces, forces/pressures with units. Reports max displacement and von Mises stress with locations, safety factor against yield, an equilibrium check (reactions vs loads) and mesh convergence (a second solve on a 0.7x finer mesh).

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | name | **yes** |  |  | Object to operate on. |
| `material` | string |  |  |  | Material grade with strength data (E, Poisson, density, yield): steel_s235, steel_s355, stainless_304, aluminium_6061, aluminium_7075, aluminium_5754, titanium, brass, pla, petg, abs, nylon_pa12. Default: the material assigned to the part with the 'material' op. Generic materials (steel, aluminium) are refused: their yield strength depends on the grade. |
| `fixed` | selector | **yes** |  |  | Faces held fixed, e.g. '<X' (the bolted face). |
| `loads` | loads | **yes** |  |  | List of {"faces": selector, "force": "500 N", "direction": [0, 0, -1]} (total force spread over the faces) or {"faces": selector, "pressure": "0.5 MPa"} (pushes into planar faces). |
| `mesh_size` | number |  |  | > 0 | Element size in mm. Default: about the wall thickness (estimated as 2 x volume / area), which suits deflection; give a smaller size for stresses near holes and corners (see convergence). |
| `convergence` | bool |  | `true` |  | Solve twice (mesh size and 0.7x) and report how much the results change. |
| `require` | object |  |  |  | Assertions that fail the step: {"min_safety_factor": 2} and/or {"max_displacement": 0.5} (mm). |
| `report` | path |  |  |  | Write a PNG stress map (4 views). |
| `keep` | bool |  | `false` |  | Keep the analysis (mesh, results) in the document for review in the FreeCAD GUI. |

Estimates only: linear elastic, small deformations, no contact. Printed plastics are weaker between layers. Peak stress at sharp inner corners is mesh-dependent (STRESS_CONCENTRATION warning): add fillets. A check that could not run is a warning (NO_CONVERGENCE_CHECK, NO_EQUILIBRIUM_CHECK): the result is then unverified.

```json
{"op": "fem_static", "target": "Bracket", "material": "aluminium_6061_t6", "fixed": "<X", "loads": [{"faces": ">X", "force": "200 N", "direction": [0, 0, -1]}], "require": {"min_safety_factor": 2}, "report": "stress.png"}
```

## Output

### `export`

Export objects to STEP, IGES, BREP, STL, OBJ or 3MF, or as a flat 2D outline (DXF, SVG) for laser/CNC cutting, and verify the written file by reading it back. STEP files carry each part's name, and an assembly as a product structure (every part once, placed as often as it is used).

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `filename` | path | **yes** |  |  | Output path relative to the workspace; the extension sets the format (.step/.stp, .iges/.igs, .brep, .stl, .obj, .3mf, .dxf, .svg). |
| `view` | enum |  | `"top"` | `top` \| `bottom` \| `front` \| `back` \| `right` \| `left` | DXF/SVG: direction of the flat projection, in model millimetres (1:1). |
| `targets` | names |  |  |  | Objects to export. Default: all result objects. |
| `tolerance` | number |  | `0.05` | > 0 | Mesh formats: max chordal deviation in mm. |
| `angular_tolerance` | number |  | `15` | > 0; ≤ 90 | Mesh formats: max angular deviation in degrees. |

### `drawing`

Make a 2D technical drawing (TechDraw page): front, plan and side views at a standard scale, overall and hole dimensions checked against the model, ISO title block; written as DXF. The page is kept in the .FCStd for PDF export in the GUI.

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `filename` | path | **yes** |  |  | Output .dxf path relative to the workspace. |
| `targets` | names |  |  |  | Objects to draw. Default: all solid result objects. |
| `sheet` | enum |  | `"A4"` | `A4` \| `A3` | Paper size (landscape). |
| `projection` | enum |  | `"first_angle"` | `first_angle` \| `third_angle` | View arrangement: ISO first angle (plan below, left view on the right) or third angle. |
| `scale` | number |  |  | > 0 | Fixed scale (e.g. 0.5 for 1:2). Default: largest standard scale that fits. |
| `dimensions` | enum |  | `"overall_and_holes"` | `none` \| `overall` \| `overall_and_holes` | Dimensions to add. |
| `iso` | bool |  | `false` |  | Add a small isometric view. |
| `title` | string |  |  |  | Title block: title (default: the part's label). |
| `author` | string |  |  |  | Title block: creator. |
| `material` | string |  |  |  | Title block: material. |
| `number` | string |  |  |  | Title block: drawing number. |
| `preview` | path |  |  |  | Also write a PNG preview rendered from the DXF (geometry and dimension lines; no text). |
| `name` | newname |  |  |  | Name of the new object (identifier). Default: auto ('Drawing', 'Drawing001', ...). |

Re-running with the same name regenerates the page (do this after editing the model). PDF/SVG pages need the FreeCAD GUI. For a flat 1:1 outline for laser/CNC cutting, use 'export' with a .dxf or .svg filename instead.

```json
{"op": "drawing", "filename": "bracket.dxf", "title": "Bracket", "author": "ACME", "material": "Aluminium 6061"}
```

### `render`

Render shaded PNG views of the model for a visual check (headless, no GUI needed). Look at the image to confirm features are where you intended.

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `filename` | path | **yes** |  |  | Output .png path relative to the workspace. |
| `views` | views |  | `["iso", "front", "top", "right"]` |  | Views in reading order (2 per row). Choices: iso, front, back, left, right, top, bottom. |
| `targets` | names |  |  |  | Objects to render. Default: all result objects. |
| `size` | integer |  | `400` | ≥ 64; ≤ 2048 | Pixel size of each square view (the sheet adds 2 px separators between views). |

All views share one scale (see mm_per_pixel in the result). front looks along +Y, right along -X, top along -Z; iso looks from the front-right-top corner. Each view has an axis triad bottom-left: X red, Y green, Z blue.

```json
{"op": "render", "filename": "preview.png", "views": ["iso", "top"]}
```
